cycle_order_diagnostic.scope: Conservative source-ID verdicts on this dataset only; no general invariance theorem or CID invariance claimed.

diagnostic: source-level model checks, not independent scientific validation

missingness_controls.scope_note: Controls alter the source graph, not captured evidence or certified engine output. Removing one already-lost parent does not by itself rescue an all-support-lost node.

policy: legacy all-support-lost, any-unknown precedence, no empty-support invalidation; grounds and derives treated alike; no supersedes boundaries in this paper dataset

selection.reason: All cohort papers have a one-hop support path from either seed by selection. Longer paths exist, but the reported depth-1 reachability does not isolate multihop impact from direct seed citations.

self_tests: one lost parent plus intact parent remains weakened
outside recorded seed not silently applied
explicit joint seed scope changes verdict
shared_inputs: Pinned captured citations and declared cycle cuts are shared with the POC. Python synchronous fixed point and source IDs are independent of CAS construction/Rust topological traversal. Agreement validates this implementation/model pair, not scientific truth or novelty.
unvalidated: citation intent and whether listed citations are necessary/alternative support
human correctness labels and empirical precision/recall
global or simultaneous refutation support in the public CLI
